loops.name: shipping digest
loops.stop_rule: publishes the latest seven-day window; never invents activity
loops.note: Collects public GitHub activity and publishes a seven-day factual digest. It can add a grounded model summary when an API key is present; all twelve recorded runs used deterministic output at $0.

loops.name: positioning review
loops.gate: weak deterministic checks · optional model judge · no retry
loops.stop_rule: records at most one recommendation, or none when no candidate clears the gate
loops.note: Reads public work and selected site source, then records a recommendation. Its PR does not contain the proposed site change; Elliot still has to implement, edit or reject it.

proposals.shipped: Elliot implemented the live writing feed separately after accepting the recommendation.
proposals.title: Link new writing: The Loop Was Never the Hard Part
proposals.rationale: Post "The Loop Was Never the Hard Part" (Mon, 13 Jul 2026) was not linked anywhere on the site. https://medium.com/@elliotJL/the-loop-was-never-the-hard-part-5bdd4352acab
proposals.change: Review and, if employer-relevant, surface this on the site.

decisions.title: Surface the latest Medium writing on Built
decisions.human_decision: I accepted the recommendation, then implemented the live writing feed myself. The agent's pull request recorded the suggestion; it did not make the site change.

failures.title: The digest ran; its own telemetry disappeared
failures.effect: The scheduled runs on 2, 3 and 4 August succeeded, but the page still reported 1 August because the workflow committed the digest and spend ledger while silently discarding data/loops.json.
failures.change: Commit the run record with the other generated files and backfill the three successful runs. The page now reports 12 successful runs through 4 August.

failures.title: A substring check presented itself as a perfect evaluation
failures.effect: The first recommendation scored 1.00 because it named a real source, avoided cosmetic words in its title and supplied more than forty characters of rationale. That checks form, not whether the change was good.
failures.change: Remove the score from the public evidence and label the gate accurately as weak. It needs real edited and rejected recommendations before its rubric can claim rigour.

failures.title: The first refresh failed after its write markers were removed
failures.effect: The script could no longer identify the agent-owned section of /now and stopped rather than risk overwriting the page.
failures.change: Restore the markers and keep the hard failure when either marker is missing. A later run succeeded with the guard intact.
